incidents.summary: TP ICAP Global Markets Americas agreed to a $400,000 FINRA settlement after inaccurately reporting approximately 600,000 securities transactions between July 2016 and May 2023.

sources.title: FINRA fines TP ICAP Global Markets Americas $400,000 for reporting deficiencies - FX News Group
sources.quote: TP ICAP Global Markets Americas LLC, formerly known as ICAP Securities USA LLC (ICAP) has agreed to pay a $400,000 fine as a part of a settlement with the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).

sources.title: FINRA fines TP ICAP Global Markets Americas $400,000 for reporting deficiencies - FX News Group
sources.quote: Between July 2016 and May 2023, ICAP inaccurately reported to the Trade Reporting and Compliance Engine (TRACE) approximately 600,000 transactions in TRACE- Eligible Securities without the required “No Remuneration” (NR) indicator in violation of FINRA Rules 6730(d) and 2010.

incidents.summary: Christine O’Reilly sued TP ICAP alleging failure to protect her from years of client harassment; in September 2025, the court granted TP ICAP’s partial motion to dismiss her ninth and tenth causes of action.

sources.title: Broker Sues TP ICAP (TCAP LN), Citigroup (C) Over Trader’s Alleged Harassment - Bloomberg
sources.quote: A broker at a unit of interdealer brokerage TP ICAP Group Plc sued her employer and Citigroup Inc. alleging both firms failed to protect her from a trader at the Wall Street bank who she claims harassed her for years.
